'''Portillo''' was a member of the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who worked as a [[Doctor/Legends|physician]] during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In the [[Standard month/Legends|months]] that followed the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Doctor Portillo was among the Gungans who emigrated from their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] as part of the [[Colonization of Ohma-D'un/Legends|colonization effort]] of the [[Water/Legends|water]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]]. The physician came to work at the [[mediglobe]] of [[New Otoh Gunga]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the Ohma-D'un settlement.<ref name="TGF" />
